confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregator estimates (Wise, Almurakib, a Thai travel budget guide, and cost-of-living sites) for Koh Lanta, and they often disagree. Beer and cappuccino are the best supported. Cocktail and wine are weaker; cocktail is set from the local beer relationship and wine from general Thai tourist pricing, not direct Koh Lanta menu data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates. I ran one accommodation-related search by mistake, which the request excluded, and I did not use its results. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure I could verify (2026-03-20), not a rate for the generation date. I found no official RBA figure after that date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southern Thai tourist islands and Andaman-coast beach towns, using Koh Lanta-specific aggregator data where available, cross-checked against general Thai beach-town pricing.
